title: Juicy Umami British Beef Stew
description: A hearty, one-pot stew originating from British cuisine, featuring a rich umami flavor from bouillon cubes and a tender, juicy texture from the beef. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots, potatoes, and red bell pepper to the pot. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the beef broth to the pot, whisking constantly. Bring to a boil.
Return the browned beef to the pot and add the bouillon cubes, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, and black pepper.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
